name: Shiranui Yozaburou
source:
Usually just called Yo. He is one of the bodyguards hired to save Hatsuhime, and is the youngest of the group. He resents being treated like a child, and is from a ninja family.
Although he looks quite young at first glance, he has a very sharp tongue.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yo-Jin-Bo#Characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
